When two overlap, a fit, panic or breakdown erupts. Resting at the Inn or praying at a Shrine calms them, and they sometimes fade on their own once you leave the Labyrinth.
부상·질병과 HP는 저절로 낫지 않는다 — 여관(매달 값이 오른다)에서: Injuries, disease and HP don't heal on their own — rest at the Inn (its price rises monthly) or use bandages, decoctions or potions. A lost hand or foot needs the Temple's regeneration rite ({regen}G) or a prosthetic from the Smithy ({prosthetic}G). A lost head or torso means instant death.

Warrior skills use weapon attacks (STR·DEX); Mage spells use INT. Mixing the two lines splits your stats, so pick a main one before special training.
